name: Generation Systems in Electric Transportation
description: Review of powertrain architectures of hybrid electric vehicles, more-electric aircrafts and ships. Topologies and control of generation systems based on permanent magnet machines. Topologies and control of generation systems based on non-permanent magnet non-salient machines. Topologies and control of generation systems based on non-permanent magnet machines based on reluctance principle. Integrated starter-generator systems, emerging generation systems.
